keys.error.400.page.title: 400 — Bad request · XIRO
keys.error.400.heading: Bad Request
keys.error.400.description_html:
The data sent is invalid or malformed.
Review the form and try again.
keys.error.401.page.title: 401 — Unauthorized · XIRO
keys.error.401.heading: Unauthorized
keys.error.401.description_html:
This action requires that you are logged in.
Sign in with your administrator credentials to continue.
keys.error.403.page.title: 403 — Access Denied · XIRO
keys.error.403.heading: Access denied
keys.error.403.description_html:
You do not have permissions to access this area.
If you are an editor, some actions are reserved for the administrator.
keys.error.404.page.title: 404 — Page not found · XIRO
keys.error.404.heading: Page not found
keys.error.404.description_html:
The PIN or route you are looking for does not exist on the server.
Check the URL or return to the start to join a game.
keys.error.410.page.title: 410 — Deleted resource · XIRO
keys.error.410.heading: Deleted resource
keys.error.410.description_html:
This game or resource no longer exists on the server.
It may have expired or been permanently deleted by the administrator.
keys.error.429.page.title: 429 — Too many requests · XIRO
keys.error.429.heading: Too many requests
keys.error.429.description_html:
You have exceeded the limit of allowed requests.
The system has temporarily blocked your connection. Wait a few seconds and try again.
keys.error.500.page.title: 500 — Internal error · XIRO
keys.error.500.heading: Internal Server Error
keys.error.500.description: Something has gone wrong on the server. It may be a specific problem with the database or Redis. The team has already been notified.
keys.error.503.page.title: 503 — Service not available · XIRO
keys.error.503.heading: Service not available
keys.error.503.description_html:
The server is temporarily down or overloaded.
Wait a few moments and try again.
keys.error.maintenance.page.title: Maintenance · XIRO
keys.error.maintenance.heading: We are improving XIRO
keys.error.maintenance.description_html:
The system is performing maintenance or backup tasks.
Come back in a few minutes, the chameleon will be ready very soon!
keys.error.maintenance.contact_note: If the problem persists, contact your system administrator.
